create_pipeline_init: create a Pipeline instance with Valves config for LibreTranslate filter integration
run_translate: run the translate method to translate text from a source language to a target language via LibreTranslate API
test_inlet: test the inlet method to translate incoming user messages before they reach the chat model
test_outlet: test the outlet method to translate outgoing assistant messages after they are generated
review_pipeline_valves: review the Pipeline.Valves class to configure LibreTranslate URL, language pairs, and pipeline priorities
